name: Trade Contract 4
definition: Agreement between the parties, stipulating the terms and conditions of the delivery of goods or services.

ContractDocumentIdentification.name: Contract Document Identification
ContractDocumentIdentification.definition: Contract document referenced from this trade agreement.

TradeTypeIdentification.name: Trade Type Identification
TradeTypeIdentification.definition: Type code of the trade contract.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Party that is specified as the buyer for this trade agreement.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Party that is specified as the seller for this trade agreement.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Planned final payment date at the time of issuance.

ProlongationFlag.name: Prolongation Flag
ProlongationFlag.definition: Indicates whether the contract duration is extended or not.|When absent, the flag meaning is NotApplicable.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Start date of the trade contract.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Currency in which the trade is being settled.

ExchangeRateInformation.name: Exchange Rate Information
ExchangeRateInformation.definition: Provides details on the currency exchange rate and contract.

PaymentSchedule.name: Payment Schedule
PaymentSchedule.definition: Schedule of the payments defined for the trade contract.

Attachment.name: Attachment
Attachment.definition: Documents provided as attachments to the trade contract.
